description.en: The name of the account. You can call the [DescribeAccounts](~~DescribeAccounts~~) operation to obtain the name of the account.

description.zh: 新密码。长度为8~32位，需包含大写字母、小写字母、特殊字符和数字中的至少三种，允许的特殊字符包括`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`。
description.en: The new password for the account. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length. It must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. Special characters include `!@ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =`
The ID of the instance to which the account belongs.

description.zh: 本参数仅用于内部维护使用，无需传入。
description.en: This parameter is used only for internal maintenance. You do not need to specify this parameter.

descriptions.zh: > 本接口仅支持4.0或以上版本的Redis实例。
descriptions.en: >  Only Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instances of Redis 4.0 or later are supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore reset-account-password --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --account-name demoaccount --account-password uWonno_2210000 --source-biz SDK --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore ResetAccountPassword --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --SourceBiz SDK --AccountName demoaccount --AccountPassword uWonno_2210000
